styleAuthority: Existing touchline-ink-1 player portraits; original 2D sports comedy scenes inspired by Tape to Tape.

assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Repaint a football management game environment from scratch in a SIMPLE FLAT 2D SPORTS COMEDY CARTOON style.
INPUT 1 is the project's ACTUAL player portrait contact sheet: this is the strict visual-style authority. Match its bold dark navy outlines (#18232a), clean closed shapes, limited matte cel colors, one hard-edged shadow tone per object, angular goofy shapes, simple SVG-like readability. INPUT 2 is the OLD courtyard: use ONLY its object placement and camera, discard ALL its rendering/materials/detail.
Aim for the irreverent hand-drawn sports comedy and wonky prop exaggeration of Tape to Tape, with entirely original football buildings and props.
Output a landscape 16:10 complete background, no text or labels. Preserve the following approximate hotspot layout: locker-room squat clubhouse with open doors and one green shirt x13-31%, y28-51%; training pitch and comically oversized orange cones x29-54% y7-25%; stadium grandstand and arched entrance x61-98% y2-26%; wonky tactics chalkboard and tiny dugout x39-52% y31-51%; manager finance office window with giant calculator and ledger x79-99% y34-56%; scouting yellow van with absurdly big wheels and roof suitcase x1-31% y56-89%; paper kiosk x40-60% y63-82%, stack of blank newspapers left and giant chunky blank-screen CRT right; small VHS archive box at x61-68% y76-89%; trophy cabinet with one oversized crooked golden boot x79-99% y62-92%. Spacious simple paths connect all objects, minimal props.
VISUAL RULES: Large clean cartoon silhouettes. Every exterior contour visibly bold and dark (roughly 5px at 1600px width), with a few thinner interior lines. Flat sage-green ground and cream paving with only 3-5 cracks, huge rounded broccoli-like tree masses, no individually drawn leaves. Squashed and stretched buildings, bent roofs, oversized doors. Cream walls, teal doors, mustard yellow props, muted red roofs, sage green lawns. Only 12-16 flat colors. Flat overhead daylight, single hard shadow shape under each building. Keep ground uncluttered. Make cartoon irreverence visible through bent objects and exaggerated scale.
ABSOLUTELY NO realism, photorealism, 3D, painterly shading, gradients, ambient occlusion, sunlight bloom, fine texture, stippling, hatching, woodgrain, stone texture, realistic reflections, cinematic atmosphere, detailed ivy, individual bricks, tiny foliage or rustic watercolor scenery. No humans, no player portraits baked in, no logos, no text, no signage. This must look like a hand-inked cartoon game map drawn by the same artist as INPUT 1, NOT an illustrated realistic architectural environment.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original production environment for a goofy football manager game. INPUT 1 is the actual SVG-style player portrait contact sheet, INPUT 2 is the new club courtyard environment; both are STYLE REFERENCES, not content to copy into this room. Match these assets closely: bold dark navy-black ink outlines (#18232a), clean closed shapes, large matte flat color areas, at most one hard cel-shadow color per surface, simplified chunky objects, funny squashed and stretched silhouettes. Inspired by the irreverent cartoon sports comedy of Tape to Tape, with original football props. Landscape 16:10. This is simple 2D cartoon animation background art that belongs behind the flat portrait characters, with no realistic materials.
Scene: inside a small absurd amateur football club's changing room, straight-on wide camera with very shallow perspective. A broad EMPTY teal-painted wall occupies the central 85% from y22% to y80%: keep this wall very simple with 5 or 6 broad vertical panels only, no lockers, no shelves or seats in that reserved region, because real interactive player lockers will be inserted here. The TOP 20% has three comically skewed high windows, a tilted clock with hands but NO digits, a thick crooked water pipe and 4 pennants. A hilariously oversized bent coat hook on the far left edge, a clipboard on a crooked door at far left, a dangling orange whistle at right edge, a shower opening at far right with one twisted towel. The BOTTOM 18% contains a low lopsided bench across the frame and 2 very chunky football boots with one enormous sock and one scuffed football under it. Big simple terracotta floor polygons with few joints. Limited palette of teal (#326d64), deep teal (#214d4b), warm tan timber (#b99648), cream (#eee0bb), mustard and dull red. Thick 5px outer outlines at 1600px width. Flat uniform light, no shafts or glows. Few large objects, no tiny clutter.
NO people, portraits, jerseys, players, letters, logos, readable statistics or UI. ABSOLUTELY NO realistic texture, woodgrain, fabric weave, brick detail, gradients, soft lighting, bloom, ambient occlusion, photographic perspective, painterly detail or 3D. Simple flat-color comic background; preserve the vast clean central wall.

At front left 3 thick VHS cassettes leaning at goofy angles. Far right coffee mug with spoon bent by sheer use. On upper wall 3 rectangular pinned blank sheets and one simple window.
